business_problem: RBI wanted to use AI to automate repetitive tasks like documenting intelligence and more rapidly summarizing legal, regulation, and banking documents.
solution_summary: Raiffeisen Bank International built this solution on Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search. RBI wanted to use AI to automate repetitive tasks like documenting intelligence and more rapidly summarizing legal, regulation, and banking documents. Azure OpenAI Service provides the generative AI model layer used for summarization, drafting, classification, or copilots in the workflow. Azure AI Search indexes enterprise content so assistants and applications can retrieve grounded answers. The company built the RBI ChatGPT, using Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service and Azure AI Search within Azure AI Foundry. With Azure AI Foundry , RBI used Azure OpenAI Service and Azure AI Search as primary tools. The rollout also connects with knowledge base so users can work inside existing operating processes. Business results include the RBI ChatGPT was first deployed to 2,000 users and now has an active user base of over 20,000.
